verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-configurable automation or workflow feature that runs autonomously in the background. The Paddle MCP server lets agents act on demand through natural-language requests, not on a recurring schedule. Webhooks and APIs are developer building blocks, and Payment Recovery retries are a fixed built-in billing behavior with configurable settings, not a general automation capability. Scheduled key rotation runs inside AWS Secrets Manager, so it is a host-platform feature rather than Paddle's own.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
